decision.rationale: I'm declining this because the ledger shows two separate purchases, not one purchase charged twice. The dispute was opened on 2026-10-30, 62 days after TXN-007908 posted on 2026-08-29, which is within the 120-day time limit. The ledger has two OAKHOLLOW PANTRY (MER-000046) purchases of 137.28 EUR on this card. TXN-007907 was made at 2026-08-27T20:51:13Z and posted 2026-08-28 under authorisation AUTH-008115. TXN-007908 was made at 2026-08-28T02:51:13Z and posted 2026-08-29 under authorisation AUTH-008116. The postings do not share an authorisation: each has its own approved contactless authorisation, and the two were made about six hours apart. There is no refund at this merchant on the card. Under duplicate-separate-authorisations, two postings with their own authorisations made some time apart count as two purchases, even when the merchant and amount are the same, so the dispute is declined.

proposed_actions.reason: The two OAKHOLLOW PANTRY charges of 137.28 EUR each have their own approval and were made about six hours apart, on 2026-08-27 and 2026-08-28. They are recorded as two separate purchases, not one purchase charged twice.
